others.route: Work permit (Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs)

note: Iraq: a foreign worker in the private sector needs the work permit the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs' Foreign Workers Section issues to skilled workers, on a certificate of expertise the Ministry of Foreign Affairs approves, the employer hiring as many Iraqis as foreigners (the Ministry's mechanism of March 2025, from a news report). The Kurdistan Region's own 2024 regulation isn't modelled apart. No days without it.

sources.title: Channel 8, Iraq's Labor Ministry Outlines New Work Permit Mechanism for Foreign Workers (March 2025, quoting the Ministry's spokesperson to INA)
sources.said: Ministry spokesperson Najm Al-Aqabi told the Iraqi News Agency (INA) that the Foreign Workers Section within the Directorate of Labor and Vocational Training is tasked with issuing work permits to skilled foreign workers.
